user.title: Connect vehicle
user.description: Use your vehicle VIN and Bearer JWT from the official Proton e.MAS app traffic or developer tooling.

reconfigure.title: Update token
reconfigure.description: Paste a fresh Bearer JWT for vehicle {vin}. Tokens expire periodically.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate
reauth_confirm.description: The saved token for vehicle {vin} was rejected (expired, or the mobile app logged in again). Paste a fresh Bearer JWT.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach vehicle cloud API

init.title: Advanced settings
init.description: Adjust polling or overrides matching intercepted mobile-app headers.

refresh_vehicle.name: Refresh vehicle status
refresh_vehicle.description: Poll the cloud now for vehicle telemetry instead of waiting for the next scheduled interval.

vin.name: VIN
vin.description: Optional vehicle VIN to refresh only that entry; leave empty to refresh every configured vehicle.

remote_climate_start.name: Remote climate start
remote_climate_start.description: Starts preconditioning with given temperature and duration for the matching VIN.

temperature.name: Temperature
temperature.description: Target cabin temperature (°C) for this run only.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Runtime in minutes for this run only.

token_expiring.title: Proton e.MAS token expires soon
token_expiring.description: The Bearer token for {title} expires on {expires}. Capture a fresh token from the mobile app and use **Reconfigure** on the integration entry to replace it before it stops working.
